name: tsumi
description: Requires pstack. Daiki Tsutsumi's agent-development approach as skills: fix agent failures in order - tools, JSON schemas, and templates first; automated checks and regression evals second; prompt rules only for judgment that cannot be encoded; human review only for suspicious output. Includes tsumi-mode (router over pstack's poteto-mode), agent-design-review, clear-japanese, and session-insights (command-only).
